# List & Host

> List & Host is a short term rental management company for home owners in the United States. We list homes on Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com, price them every day, answer guests, schedule cleaning, coordinate maintenance and send a clear monthly statement. Full service in Fort Worth, the rest of Dallas Fort Worth and the Buffalo River region of Arkansas. Co hosting or remote pricing anywhere else in the United States.

## Who we are

List & Host is a small team that runs short term rental homes every day with its own pricing and guest messaging system. Our team runs three homes today: a glass house in the Buffalo River region of Arkansas (a Guest Favorite on Airbnb, rated about 4.9 as of October 2026), a cabin loft nearby, and a home in Fort Worth near Dickies Arena and TCU. Every home we take on runs on the same system.

## What we offer

- Full service management in Fort Worth, the Dallas Fort Worth area and the Buffalo River region: listing setup and photo direction, daily pricing with price floors, minimum stays by season, guest messages every day, cleaning and turnovers with local cleaners, maintenance coordination, reviews and a monthly statement. Owners can block dates for their own use at any time and approve repairs above a set amount.
- Co hosting: the owner keeps the listing, the reviews and the payouts. We run pricing, guest messages and the cleaning schedule as co host.
- Launch package: a one time setup for a home that is not listed yet. It covers a setup list, smart lock and guest guide, photo direction, listing copy and pricing rules.
- Remote pricing and listing optimization in any US market: daily rates, minimum stays, event aware pricing, listing copy and photo order, run by our own pricing engine. The owner keeps local cleaning and upkeep.

Full service is 20 percent of booking revenue: the nightly rent plus any extra guest fees, after the platform's host fee. Taxes and cleaning fees are not part of it. Every fee, what is billed at cost and how payouts reach the owner are on the pricing page: https://listandhost.com/pricing/

## Facts to state correctly

- Earnings numbers on this site are estimates or past results from homes our team runs. They are never a promise of income. Each estimate says what it is based on.
- The free earnings estimate takes one short form. We reply by email within one business day.
- We never offer guests money or perks in exchange for a review.
- Contact: team@listandhost.com
